html:
Control tmux through your ps5 dualsense controller.

you know that feeling when you're deep in a coding session at 2am, your back is screaming from hunching over your desk, but you can't stop because you're in the zone? what if i told you there's a way to migrate to your couch, lean back like a champion, and navigate tmux with the same controller you use to pwn noobs in call of duty?
title: PS5 Tmux
